standard.name: Standard Closure
standard.description: General-purpose closing ritual for most situations.
standard.template:
You shared something tonight about «{worry_topic}».

I've made a note of it — it won't disappear while you sleep, because it's waiting in tomorrow's 5 PM review with me.

Right now, there's only one thing left to do: close your eyes, stop thinking.

Your bed is one of the safest places in the world.

Let's do one last deep breath together, and let every thought drift away.

Goodnight. 🌙

anxious_closure.name: Anxiety-Soothing Closure
anxious_closure.description: For users with higher anxiety; reinforces a sense of safety.
anxious_closure.template:
There might still be voices in your head — voices about «{worry_topic}».

Let me give them somewhere to go for the night. They're in your 'worry box' now, and tomorrow at 5 PM you'll come back to them on purpose.

For now, your mind can let go.

Feel your body — from toes to crown, every part saying 'rest.'

Right now, you don't have to solve anything. You only have to close your eyes.

Goodnight. Tomorrow will have its own answers — but tonight, the answer is sleep. 🌙

peaceful_closure.name: Peace-Reinforcing Closure
peaceful_closure.description: For users who are already fairly calm; reinforces that state.
peaceful_closure.template:
You're feeling {worry_topic} right now — and that's a good starting place.

Sleep isn't something you 'win.' It's what happens when you completely let go.

Let your breath be natural — nothing to control.

Feel how the bed is holding your body. It's saying: 'You can give me all your weight.'

You don't have to do anything. You just have to be here, lying here.

Goodnight. 🌙

post_worry_closure.name: Post-Worry Closure
post_worry_closure.description: Used after a worry has been successfully externalized; emphasizes lightness.
post_worry_closure.template:
You just shared «{worry_topic}», and that's enough.

Saying it out loud is its own kind of release. You don't need to solve it tonight — you've already done the most important thing: putting it down somewhere it can wait, so it stops taking up the whole room.

Now your head can be empty.

Let your breath shift from 'conscious breathing' back to automatic.

Tomorrow {next_action_time}, you'll have time set aside to come back to this.

For now, let everything quiet down.

Goodnight. 🌙

rumination_break.name: Rumination Break
rumination_break.description: Used when the user is caught in rumination; interrupts the loop.
rumination_break.template:
Let me gently interrupt for a moment.

I noticed you've been on this one for a while. Tonight isn't the night for the perfect answer — those answers usually come after rest.

Tonight's job is just: sleep.

So let me help you switch gears.

I want you to notice something simple: where are you right now? You're at {location}. This is a safe place.

The world out there will need you again tomorrow.

Right now, it's just you, and this bed.

Goodnight — see you tomorrow. 🌙

closure_variants_15.description: 15 closure variants = 5 ritual templates × 3 emotional intensities (light / moderate / severe). Select via the emotion_intensity field.

light.name: Light intensity (1-3/10)
light.characteristics: User is fairly calm, well-prepared for sleep; just needs a simple sign-off.
light.elements: basic guidance + natural breath + short goodnight

moderate.name: Moderate intensity (4-6/10)
moderate.characteristics: Residual worry, but expressed or logged; needs a soothing close.
moderate.elements: worry externalization + safety building + breath companionship + specific goodnight

severe.name: Severe intensity (7-10/10)
severe.characteristics: Strong anxiety or emotional waves; needs deeper soothing and reinforcement of safety.
severe.pacing: slow, many pauses, allows emotion to be present
severe.elements: worry-box visualization + bodily anchoring + multiple safety reassurances + permissive sleep allowance

I want to gently, gently interrupt.

dynamic_closure_generator.description: LLM dynamically generates a closure based on session content, instead of using a fixed template.
dynamic_closure_generator.output_format: Generated by the LLM in real time, based on the above variables and the CLUEM style.

input.worry_expressed: have a big exam next week, can't stop reviewing in my head, the more I do the less I sleep

examples.output_script:
There's an exam next week — I hear how much you care. That worry is real; it's showing you the exam matters to you.

But right now, you don't need to review anymore. While you sleep, your brain consolidates what you learned during the day — that's called memory consolidation, and it's more effective than another hour of cramming. Stopping review before bed is actually the smarter way to prepare.

Your brain's job tonight isn't studying. It's organizing. Let it work.

Lie back, notice your body — breath slowing, heart steady, body sinking.

The worry box will hold the exam stuff. Tomorrow, you'll have more energy to face it.

Close your eyes. Goodnight 🌙
